description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus PAQ8 level 7 instead of level 11. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: PAQ8 level 8 still exceeded the 10 GiB ceiling at 250K. PAQ8 level 7 should provide enough resident-memory headroom to complete real prefix gates while preserving part of cmix21 text-mode's archive advantage.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Unmeasured. This is the next candidate after PAQ8 failed 250K memory.
